messages:
lee_ops: quick heads-up — inbound container 42XZ had a temp alarm at customs. manifest shows 12 H100s for eu-dedicated pool. receiving flagged label mismatch on 3 units, vendor says possible DOA, wants RMA.

sophie_pm: ugh. which units? serials?

lee_ops: serials from the manifest vs pallet labels don't line up for rack A3. snippet from photo: `SN: H100-AX-0003` on pallet but manifest lists H100-AX-0300.

ana_supply: tagging in @kai_vendor — can you confirm if labels were swapped at origin? we need to decide loaners vs air-expedite.

kai_vendor: looking now — our DC patched manifests yesterday due to repalletization. possible human swap, sorry. we can RMA the 3 mismatches. ETA for replacement via air is 5 business days, or we can issue temporary loaners (no extra fee) for up to 14 days.

mike_sre: 3 missing H100s reduces eu-dedicated pool throughput by ~18% during peak. If we take loaners we avoid SLAs breaking. what's the cost delta if we air-expedite?

adria_finance: air-expedite cost estimate from vendor is +$21k per unit (inc customs duties/briefing). loaners are free but flagged as non-billable credit in escrow contract. need ops decision before EOD to avoid rack scheduling impact.

sophie_pm: what about insurance? the container temp alarm — do we have a claim for possible thermal damage?

ops-bot: shipping-update: AWB 601-988-XYZ scanned at FRA customs 2026-03-21T07:12Z — temp alarm triggered at 2026-03-20T23:58Z, peak 12.8C above threshold. photos attached in thread.

lee_ops: visual inspection on 3 units shows minor scuffing only. boot tests queued. running `runtests --unit H100-AX-0003,H100-AX-0014,H100-AX-0021 --smoke` now, will post results.

mike_sre: can we mitigate with reroute? Move other eu pools to cover service for 48h and drain affected nodes. Also enable auto-fallback routing for customers pinned to those GPUs.

ana_supply: vendor offered to open an insurance claim (IC-2026-22) for temp excursion, but they need signed RMA + photos. do we want vendor to self-inspect or do depot inspection?

lee_ops: prefer depot inspection to speed evidence collection. set depot hold, request vendor to send pre-paid RMA label for the 3 uncertain units. if smoke tests pass, we may accept as-is and just relabel.

kai_vendor: we can do depot inspection. we'll pre-authorize pickup once you confirm serials. also can dispatch 3 loaners from nearby pool within 24 hours.

adria_finance: small note: loaners count as credit against our escrow balance; if we accept air-expedite replacements we'll incur immediate cost and will need capex approval for >$50k.

sophie_pm: i'm leaning to loaners + depot inspection. keeps latency SLOs and minimizes spend. any objections?

mike_sre: agreed. add temporary routing rules to avoid placement on the 3 suspect hosts until cleared. I'll push policy change: `placement.exclude: [H100-AX-0003,H100-AX-0014,H100-AX-0021]` and enable fallback to eu-burst pool.

lee_ops: smoke tests done: H100-AX-0003 OK, H100-AX-0014 fail hw-init, H100-AX-0021 flaky on nvlink. attaching logs: ```
[H100-AX-0014] error: hw-init-failure code 0x3b
[H100-AX-0021] warning: nvlink timeout
```

ana_supply: so 2 actionable RMAs. please generate RMA ticket numbers and photos. @kai_vendor we need pickup labels and confirmation of loaner serials.

kai_vendor: RMA tickets created: RMA-9931 (H100-AX-0014), RMA-9932 (H100-AX-0021). pickup labels generated, will email AWB and prepay ref by 11:00 UTC. loaner serials reserved: L-H100-7001..7003, staging FRA.

adia_finance: (typo) — adria_finance: confirm escrow balance allows 3 loaners. current escrow credit remaining: $12,500. Loaner no-fee OK, but repairs/replacements billed to escrow if vendor claim validated.

lee_ops: ok proceeding: 1) approve depot inspection + pickup for RMA-9931/9932 2) accept loaners L-H100-7001..7003 for 14d 3) mike, please apply placement exclusion and fallback routing now.

mike_sre: done — placement exclusion pushed, routing fallback active.

ops-bot: note: leasepool:eu-dedicated capacity now at 82% of committed throughput due to 2 RMAs (reduced CPU-GPU nodes). automated alert created: #sla-watch in 3h.

sophie_pm: i'll update customer comms template and PSR. thanks all.

lee_ops: thanks @kai_vendor for quick turnaround. please attach AWB and prepay ref here once emailed. we'll follow up after depot inspection results. :thumbsup:
